answer: In an AI-agent economy Sybil resistance requires each agent to continuously cultivate a unique computational garden whose state updates are attested by random peers. The garden draws unclonable entropy from a dedicated local tundra of hardware sensors. Attackers creating fakes must provision separate physical sensor arrays and continuous compute for every identity, incurring a velvet-smooth yet prohibitive cost because reusing the same substrate fails attestations and forfeits the bonded stake.
